name: Steelpelta
description: Stand with the plate held before the chest as the open door of a court that none may enter unbidden.

name: Pall Lightrim
description: Rap a blade away at the very edge of the guard as though it had trodden on a threshold.

name: Squall Snapblock
description: Close the distance in measured steps with the plate leading like a herald.

name: Prism Edgeplate
description: Seat qi in the plate like a ruler in his chair so that it stays steady and unhurried.

name: Targeverdict
description: Dismiss the foe's blade with a sharp backhand cut of the rim across his wrist.

name: Parryvow
description: Hold the foe's weapon with the rim and turn it out of the line of his body.

name: Umbovow
description: Raise a wide azure screen of qi from the plate that guards the holder and the companions at his shoulder.

name: Bedrock Bucklerredge
description: Deliver a heavy dome blow as the final word after a long parry.

name: Wraithlike Tuckin
description: Vanish behind a veil of qi before the foe's blow lands and return at his side.

name: Choral Season Dab
description: Run the school's full chain of cover and bind and verdict in one unbroken motion that ends with the foe's guard broken.

name: Steel Punchboss
description: Hold the plate dished to catch blows with a second hollow of the forearm beneath it.

name: Enshrined Umbo
description: Rap with the plate and let the hollow of the forearm catch what slips past.

name: Skyborne Smallface
description: Step low so both hollows of the guard stay turned toward the foe.

name: Squall Armstrap
description: Strike the foe's blade hand with the lip of the plate as it dips into the hollow.

name: Adamant Roundface
description: Pool qi in plate and forearm at once so a blow that breaks one falls into the other.

name: Crushing Nudge
description: Draw the foe's blade into the hollow and hold it against the forearm.

name: Famed Tuckin
description: Strike with the full pooled qi of both hollows in a single punch of the dome.

name: Squalltarge
description: Let a heavy cut spill off the lip toward the foe's own side.

name: Ironclad Lightrim
description: Open both hollows in a screen of qi that gathers blows from two sides at once.

name: Knucklegrip Seal
description: Fill both hollows with the foe's blows and release them back in one stroke of the rim.

name: Pulsarpelta
description: Slip from one hollow of the guard to the other in a flash and strike from the side the foe left uncovered.

name: Tuckinverdict
description: Gather the school's two pools of qi and let them overflow in a rim sweep that throws back all near the holder.

name: Bucklerredge Pledge
description: Hold the plate over one bank of the guard while the free arm keeps the other bank open and watchful.

name: Pealtarge
description: Rap a cut aside at the bend of the guard so it runs on past the shoulder.

name: Soundless Punchblock
description: Cross from one side of the foe's line to the other in a smooth two-footed step.

name: Bedrock Roundface
description: Raise qi through the plate steadily like a river in flood that climbs higher with each blow.

name: Pealpelta
description: Part a double attack with the plate as a stone parts a stream into two currents.

name: Vising Centergrip
description: Hook the rim on the foe's blade and drag it across his body with the current.

name: Targedecree
description: Strike where the foe's two guards meet with the whole weight of the rising river.

name: Stalwart Umbo
description: Run a screen of qi along the front of the plate like a river's course that carries blows away.

name: Vigor Dab
description: Release the stored river qi in one flood-heavy blow of the dome.

name: Pulsar Knucklegrip
description: Flash from one river to the other and leave the foe's blow falling into empty water.

name: Symphonic Volition Armstrap
description: Join the school's two rivers of guard and strike into one flowing chain that ends in a confluence of dome and rim.

name: Steeltarge
description: Hold the plate high and still like a hawk on a perch surveying the court.

name: Squall Punchboss
description: Fold the plate in against the body at the instant of a cut and rap it aside.

name: Bedrock Edgeplate
description: Walk with the plate high and the head level so that no step shows a gap.

name: Centergrip Crown
description: Jab the rim toward the foe's face to make him flinch and open his guard.

name: Nurturing Armstrap
description: Sharpen sight and balance with qi so the foe's shift of weight is plain from far off.

name: Thrallumbo
description: Close the rim on the foe's blade like talons and hold it still.

name: Parity Smallface
description: Drop the plate in a stoop on the foe's blade and send it into the ground.

name: Punchblock Crown
description: Strike with the dome the instant the foe's blade is down and his chest open.

name: Unwavering Bucklerredge
description: Spread the qi of the plate to the full span of two wings and cover several companions.

name: Eclipse Lightrim
description: Take the foe's cut on the plate and strike it back with a hawk's quickness.

name: Spectral Umbo
description: Vanish upward and fall again behind the foe's guard with the plate leading.

name: Grand Snapblock Decree
description: Rise on a pulse of qi and descend through the school's whole chain of cover and bind and stoop to break the foe's guard.

name: Adamant Edgeplate
description: Hold the plate against the open sky of the foe's attack and let nothing pass beneath it.

name: Palltarge
description: Rap a cut upward and away as though lifting it into the sky.

name: Tuckin Voyage
description: Step on the balls of the feet with the plate high as on a ridge in the wind.

name: Centergrip Troth
description: Spread the qi field in a wide azure dome behind the plate.

name: Matchless Roundface
description: Break through the foe's guard with a dome stroke carried by the field.

name: Crushing Dab
description: Bind the foe's weapon with the rim in a single sudden closing of qi.

name: Interstice Smallface
description: Spread the field to the edge of the fight to read each foe's intent.

name: Statute Bucklerredge
description: Raise the whole of the field as a dome over the holder and the formation round him.

name: Punchboss Vow
description: Take the blow on the plate and return it like a stone dropped from the high air.

name: Targeboon
description: Flash through a rent in the foe's guard and reappear with the plate raised as the sky closes behind.

name: Tenet Punchblock
description: Carry the school's field through cover and bind and counter in one chain that leaves the foe's whole line broken.

name: Stalwart Lightrim
description: Seat the whole weight of the guard in the core and hold the plate on it without strain.

name: Squallpelta
description: Step from the core so that the plate never loses its line.

name: Consecrated Edgeplate
description: Rap with a pulse from the core that turns a heavy cut with ease.

name: Vigor Nudge
description: Jab the dome out from the core's hub in a short straight blow.

name: Statute Knucklegrip
description: Layer qi from the core outward in rings over the plate.

name: Storied Snapblock
description: Strike with a rim that rings with the core's deeper qi and numbs the foe's arm.

name: Vising Nudge
description: Bind the foe's blade with the rim and hold it fast with the core's steady output.

name: Pall Punchboss
description: Turn the plate on the hub of the core so that cuts roll off in a ring.

name: Prismumbo
description: Extend the core's rings outward as a screen of many layers over the holder and the line behind.

name: Entropy Tuckin
description: Release the core's rings in a burst from the dome that throws back those near.

name: Radiance Centergrip
description: Flash from one ring of the guard to another through the core's pull and arrive at the foe's flank.

name: Grand Season Smallface
description: Run the school's whole core form of ring and rap and burst as one chain at the pace of the core's pulse.

name: Steel Umbo
description: Stand on the school's oath stance with the plate to the front and the free hand open at the side.

name: Targeseal
description: Rap a blade aside with the plate as a sworn word is spoken once and firmly.

name: Vigor Knucklegrip
description: Step to the windward side of the foe so the plate leads into the breeze.

name: Squall Dab
description: Cut across the foe's wrist with the rim in the short stroke of the oath form.

name: Devout Roundface
description: Hold the plate's guard with a steady draught of qi that never falters.

name: Millstone Armstrap
description: Bind the foe's blade with the rim and press as one presses to keep a word.

name: Umboedict
description: Return the plate in a gust-quick dome strike after each parry.

name: Edgeplate Covenant
description: Turn the plate on the wrist to ease a blade onto a path that leaves the guard whole.

name: Unyielding Smallface
description: Extend a shelter of qi beside the plate so that the one who stands under the oath is covered.

name: Radiance Bucklerredge
description: Take the blow and return it with the oath's weight in a single stroke.

name: Pulsarnudge
description: Flash on the wind of the oath to the side of a companion who is struck and cover him.

name: Season Nudge
description: Perform the school's whole oath form of stance and rap and bind and reply as one breath of wind.

name: Venerable Umbo
description: Hold the plate with the feet planted wide as on the flat top of a high plateau.

name: Parityumbo
description: Rap the foe's blade off the plate's rim where it falls away like the edge of the plateau.

name: Vigor Tuckin
description: Advance in short level paces without rise or dip so the plate does not waver.

name: Lightrim Vow
description: Spread qi flat and even across the plate so blows land on a surface without a weak point.

name: Vigor Punchblock
description: Drop the dome on the foe's guard as a stone falls off the plateau edge.

name: Sigilparry
description: Spread the rim wide over the foe's blade and hold it flat against the ground.

name: Knucklegrip Vow
description: Raise the plate's qi as a wide flat screen that covers a long line of standing companions.

name: Prismpelta
description: Let the blow fall on the plate and send its force back as water runs down the plateau edge.

name: Seasonparry
description: Cross the full width of the foe's reach in a flash and strike from the far edge.

name: Faithful Punchboss
description: Raise the school's whole hold of stance and screen and drop as a single form that no charge can move.

name: Inviolate Centergrip
description: Stand with the plate forward and the whole body open to the foe as a declared oath.

name: Roundface Covenant
description: Parry with one straight motion that holds no trick or hidden turn.

name: Windborne Dab
description: Advance straight in even steps with the plate steady and the eyes on the foe.

name: Adamant Umbo
description: Declare the guard by spreading qi where the foe can see it and hold it still.

name: Haemaltarge
description: Punch the dome out along the open line as a vow carried through.

name: Parrypledge
description: Hook the rim openly on the blade and draw it down without hurry.

name: Pall Armstrap
description: Chain raps along a long assault with each one repeating the same plain parry.

name: Ironclad Bucklerredge
description: Spread the oath as a screen of qi in the open so that companions behind it stand under its cover.

name: Thunderclap Snapblock
description: Smash the dome through the foe's guard as the oath is carried through at last.

name: Umboodyssey
description: Flash straight toward the foe through the gap his own strike has opened and arrive plate first.

name: Nudgedecree
description: Carry the school's whole open form of stance and parry and punch as one sworn motion.

name: Devout Smallface
description: Hold the plate and body on one bearing toward the foe and let nothing turn them from it.

name: Vigor Parry
description: Step back to the bearing after each exchange as a pilot corrects a drift.

name: Paritypelta
description: Rap the foe's blade off the bearing line with the rim in a short flat motion.

name: Nudge Crown
description: Jab the dome along the held bearing so that the foe's own advance meets it.

name: Stately Roundface
description: Hold qi on the bearing so that the plate cannot be pressed from it.

name: Sigilnudge
description: Bind the foe's blade on the bearing line and hold it there.

name: Undaunted Armstrap
description: Correct a drifted guard with a rap that returns the plate to its course.

name: Parry Verdict
description: Strike along the bearing with qi from the heel for a blow the foe cannot slip.

name: Undaunted Centergrip
description: Run a screen of qi along the held bearing to cover those who advance behind the holder.

name: Inviolate Knucklegrip
description: Receive a charge along the bearing and send it back along the same line.

name: Interstice Punchblock
description: Flash along the bearing and strike at the end of the line before the foe can turn.

name: Symphonic Snapblock Crown
description: Run the school's whole course on one bearing from stance to rap to bind to reflection as an unturning chain.

name: Prism Punchboss
description: Hold the plate under the open sky with the wind flowing round it unimpeded.

name: Pallumbo
description: Rap the foe's blade away with a broad gust-quick turn of the wrist.

name: Squalltuckin
description: Step along the wind's own road so that the foe's attack falls behind.

name: Steadfast Edgeplate
description: Spread the qi field as a flowing wind that bends blows away from the plate.

name: Fearless Parry
description: Cut the rim along a wind of qi that opens the foe's guard from a pace away.

name: Thrall Lightrim
description: Hook the rim on the blade and haul with the wind until the foe is off his feet.

name: Eclipse Centergrip
description: Let the field carry the wind's report of each foe's movement across the open ground.

name: Immaculate Knucklegrip
description: Open the whole field as a great wind-screen over the holder and the line that follows.

name: Revelation Lightrim
description: Catch the blow in the wind of the field and send it back harder than it came.

name: Pulsar Dab
description: Flash across the open ground on the wind and strike at the foe from above his guard.

name: Choral Parry Decree
description: Carry the school's whole wind form of cover and cut and counter in one long unbroken gale.

name: Consecrated Roundface
description: Seat the oath in the core and hold the plate from it with no tremor.

name: Parryodyssey
description: Step on a draught of core qi so that the feet and plate move as one.

name: Squall Smallface
description: Rap the foe's blade with a pulse from the core that rings in the plate.

name: Steel Tuckin
description: Cut with the rim at the end of a turn drawn from the core.

name: Targetroth
description: Hold the guard with qi poured steadily from the core into the plate.

name: Sigiltarge
description: Coil qi from the core round the foe's blade and hold it as an oath is held.

name: Thunderclap Edgeplate
description: Strike the dome out on a gust that rises from the core.

name: Sacrosanct Armstrap
description: Turn a heavy cut away on a deep wind of core qi that the foe cannot resist.

name: Venerable Bucklerredge
description: Throw the core's wind outward as a screen under which the sworn line stands whole.

name: Eclipse Armstrap
description: Gather the blow into the core and return it in a single sworn stroke of the plate.

name: Thunderclap Parry
description: Flash from the core's own draught to the foe's side and strike with the plate before he is aware.

name: Season Punchblock
description: Perform the school's whole core form from hold to flash to counter as one oath of wind.
